entries.title: Know who sponsors your visa
entries.fact: A student may be sponsored by a UAE-resident parent or by the accredited university or college.

entries.title: Get a university certificate that states your duration of study
entries.fact: The student visa requires a certificate from the university or institute that specifies the duration of the study. The official page states no fee and no validity period.

entries.title: Prepare the documents on the ADU visa form
entries.fact: For an international student, the 2018 ADU visa form lists a clear color passport copy (passport valid for at least 6 months), one passport-sized photo with a white background, and a "To Whom It May Concern" letter from Admission.
entries.sourceName: ADU New Visa Application Form PRO-SS-003-01 (2018)
entries.caveat: This list comes from an ADU form dated 11 February 2018. Confirm the current list and all fees with ADU.

entries.title: Attest certificates issued abroad before you travel
entries.fact: Certificates issued outside the UAE are authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the issuing country and then by the UAE embassy or consulate there.
entries.caveat: This rule is stated on an official page about employment. Ask your university which documents it wants attested.

entries.title: Take the airport bus
entries.fact: From Zayed International Airport, bus A1 runs to Al Zahiyah and A2 to Khalifa Street. A-series buses operate 24/7. A Hafilat card is required and cash is not accepted on board.
entries.sourceName: Zayed International Airport, city bus routes

entries.title: Get a Hafilat card
entries.fact: The Hafilat card is valid for five years. Passes cost AED 30 weekly, AED 80 monthly, and AED 500 annually.
entries.fee: AED 10 card; AED 2 per local trip
entries.caveat: Official pages differ on where the card is sold: ADRO names machines in Lulu Hypermarket branches, and the airport names machines near the airport bus stops.

entries.title: Use a taxi when you need one
entries.fact: A regular taxi is booked through the Abu Dhabi Taxi app or by calling 600 53 53 53.

entries.title: Get a mobile line
entries.fact: e& and du are the licensed operators. The Hesabati feature shows every number registered under an Emirates ID.
entries.caveat: The documents an operator asks for were not confirmed from an opened operator page. Ask the operator.

entries.title: Take the medical fitness test
entries.fact: Residence visa applicants aged 18 and above must take a medical test and pass a security check.
entries.sourceName: u.ae, general provisions for the residence visa
entries.caveat: Where the test is done in Abu Dhabi and what it costs were not confirmed from an official page.

entries.title: Apply for your Emirates ID
entries.fact: The Emirates ID is mandatory for all residents. The application goes through the ICP website or an accredited typing centre, and applicants aged 15 and above complete fingerprint and signature procedures at an ICP service centre.

entries.deadlineText: Within 5 days of obtaining the visa (ADU form, 2018)
entries.title: Submit your medical result and Emirates ID application to ADU
entries.fact: The medical test result and the Emirates ID application are submitted with the passport and entry permit to the Student Support Service Office within 5 days of obtaining the visa.
entries.sourceName: ADU New Visa Application Form PRO-SS-003-01 (2018)
entries.caveat: This is an ADU rule from the 2018 form, not an ICP rule. Confirm it with ADU.

entries.title: Confirm that you hold health insurance
entries.fact: Abu Dhabi health insurance is governed by Health Insurance Law No. 23 of 2005.
entries.fee: Fine of AED 300 for every uninsured month
entries.caveat: No opened official page states who must provide the cover. Ask your university.

entries.title: Register for UAE Pass
entries.fact: UAE Pass is the national digital identity and signature solution. Registration uses facial recognition and takes less than 5 minutes without a visit to a service centre. Help desk: 600 561 111.
entries.caveat: The official page does not state the registration prerequisites, such as an Emirates ID.

entries.title: If you rent off campus, expect Tawtheeq and a municipality fee
entries.fact: The landlord registers the lease in Tawtheeq. A municipality fee is then added to the tenant's water and electricity bill across 12 months.
entries.fee: 5% of the rental value or the rental index, whichever is higher
entries.sourceName: u.ae, leasing a property in the UAE
entries.caveat: No source addressed students in university dormitories. The TAMM registration fee was not verified.

entries.title: Work only with a permit
entries.fact: The Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) lists a part-time work permit and a student training and employment permit valid for three months. The establishment applies, not the student.
entries.caveat: No opened official page sets out the rules for university students aged 18 and over on a university-sponsored visa.

entries.title: Do not stay abroad for more than 180 days
entries.fact: A residence visa is nullified automatically if the resident lives outside the UAE for more than 180 days continuously, subject to listed exceptions.
entries.sourceName: u.ae, general provisions for the residence visa

entries.title: Renew your Emirates ID on time
entries.fact: Renewal later than one month after expiry incurs a late fee.
entries.fee: AED 20 per day, up to AED 1,000

entries.title: Aim for the graduate Golden Visa
entries.fact: The Abu Dhabi Residents Office lists a 10-year Golden Visa for graduates of accredited UAE universities classified A or B, with a minimum GPA of 3.5 (class A) or 3.8 (class B) and graduation no more than two years ago. Applications go through an ADRO nomination or the ICP website.
entries.sourceName: Abu Dhabi Residents Office, Golden Visa for students
entries.caveat: The class of your university (A or B) was not checked. Official pages differ on the duration for high school graduates, so Dalil does not state it.

entries.title: Get a student bank card (ADIB ISIC)
entries.fact: For everyday banking, students can get the ISIC Prepaid Card from Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB): a student payment card that carries the international ISIC discount scheme, with more than 125,000 discounts in 130 countries. It is open to students who are UAE nationals or residents, and its balance is loaded from an ADIB account. Apply online or visit an ADIB branch with your original passport, Emirates ID, two passport-sized photos with a white background, and your university ID.
entries.fee: Zero fees on deposits and withdrawals at ADIB ATMs; the page states no other fees
entries.caveat: You need your Emirates ID first. It is a prepaid card, so ask the ADIB branch about the account that loads it. Other banks were not checked.
